cache_policy: Fresh Firecracker VM and rootfs copy plus a unique database path for every lane; no host page-cache flush; first_after_fixture is not labeled cold.
evidence_basis: Run manifest pins the source and preboot rootfs hashes; the host operator log records the same pinned rootfs; the Firecracker harness creates a run-directory guest-rootfs.ext4 copy and verifies it before launch, then cleans it up after the run. Each registered lane has a fresh run ID, run directory, VM ID, volume ID, and guest database path.
